Prepared the design-only, no-automatic-retry supplement: finite ordering, preflight/freeze bindings, failure/extra/delivery decisions and operational stopping, preserving existing accounting and byte evidence.
Only two repository additions: [Markdown](../benchmark/baseline/attempt-policy-0148.md), SHA256 `22c837604524677c06e0eaad9410018c1230ce86d0e6cfd767b8f3fcaaa79e39`; [JSON](../benchmark/baseline/attempt-policy-0148.json), SHA256 `15ccbdf618ad86cf477dc2f6a680ad8fdd146cf1ced060de6cd96f77eb9797df`.
Starting commit/tree: `663ed5a3db52086590e9d2c678730519635bb9c7` / `0965767ae622c6540661844547cf56088b6ec829`; eleven governing source SHA256 pins are in JSON `/source_pins`.
The parent checkpoint is `bb62a6a648b7e24057dd3812b3e97189400d4fc8`, tree `7c204fa6f00d40ef1e057cdcd5ddd8725edda4f5`; start-to-checkpoint diff contains exactly those two additions, and working status is clean. This role invoked no git commit.
[Export manifest](exports/manifest.json) and [#678 report](exports/reports/678.json) were available/read: F2-only CLEAR at producer `e15a503340c615ad37f576de9ba5aceb99b42495`; report SHA256 `b5dbe6e88a344d3406bfee816963ee045ab9f8854ff427e14e1f1086cd9ae7f9`. No probes were replayed.
Documented boundary was reported before proposal: existing multiple-attempt slots remain unresolved with zero completion; real settings/count/quota/admission remain unavailable. One additional linked protocol-baseline section resolved matched-budget/completion requirements.
[Expectations](artifacts/attempt-policy-expectations-0148.json), SHA256 `df7fc3803b08859054b5afa7e7b107a1fec4578aff5f2e7322edaddfbe71d360`, were saved before explanatory application; initial bytes are [preserved](artifacts/attempt-policy-expectations-0148.initial.json), SHA256 `cae310cd8d7c7806571caef2a1e9cbb87de981fff49843895d5d4ac217a95e36`.
Before application, clarifications separated dispatch order from plan inventory, confined unknown outcomes to quarantine and required delivery-only proof; expected decisions stayed unchanged. Source inspection preceded expectations; no blind or independent claim.
The issue's required verification exited 0 with empty stdout/stderr. Final [design checks](artifacts/attempt-policy-design-checks-0148.json), SHA256 `c76ff17282faca3dd681ebe045faafe1fa59e899ba3ac36c09777671ded82bce`, verified source/export/plan/settings identities, both synthetic orders, all 62 manifest fields and consistency of 16 manual applications with saved decisions and the Markdown table.
These checks establish structure and author consistency, not normative validity, execution, precision, authority or readiness. No historical suite, evaluator, runner, scorer, model transport, reader or native execution occurred; no keys, payload catalogs, index or existing contracts changed.
Actual admissions, model/reader/native executions, scored runs, semantic passes and real comparisons remain zero; actual costs remain null and `benchmark_ready=false`. This author does not accept the method; no owner request, spending or capability claim is made.
## What next
Independently review the actual two-file supplement and uploaded expectations, then prepare any necessary separately scoped integration. Real configuration/quota, trusted evidence/isolation, development sizing and reviewed execution/scoring remain unavailable; whole-method independent review and owner acceptance still precede product implementation.
Resume from these pins and separate expectations/applications; avoid repeating F2 probes, the gap survey, broad history, historical suites or evaluator/model/native execution.
## Discoveries
[Startup diagnostics](startup.json) name `claude-sonnet-5-5` while parent action annotations name `codex/gpt-6.1-sol`; neither is an immutable evaluated-model identity.
